_about: Per-race notes for the high school results, keyed by the CSV file name in races/. Shown on the race page. Edit freely; rebuild with scripts/build_data.py.

2007_Episcopal_Quad_Meet_Varsity_49846.c: Tim Hadley was disqualified for cutting the course (confirmed by the team). The official printout (mocorunning.com) lists him as “Handley, Tim 15:35”; he is shown here as DQ with no place or time, and the result doesn't count toward his records.
The printout also lists “Name, Unreadable”, which is left out.

Official team score: The Heights 1st with 42 points (kept as the meet scored it). Racecast's own calculation from the listed finishers puts The Heights 2nd with 70, so the calculated scores below don't match the official ones.
2008_Woodward_Relays_2man_moco792.csv: Date: mocorunning.com files this meet under Sep 8, 2008, but the printout header says 9/11/2006. The Heights roster (Greg Hadley was in high school in 2008, not 2006) points to 2008, so 2008 is used.
Two-man relay over 6 miles; only team times are posted. Runner names are cut off in the printout (“Greg Had”), and two Heights teams are listed only as “Relay #3” and “Relay #4” with no names.
2019_Bullis_Invitational_JV_moco7159.csv: Date: mocorunning.com says Sep 7, 2019, but the results header says 8/31/2019; the header date is used.
2019_Bullis_Invitational_Varsity_moco715: Date: mocorunning.com says Sep 7, 2019, but the results header says 8/31/2019; the header date is used.
2010_Glory_Days_Invitational_Freshman_16: On mocorunning.com the boys freshman team-score table sits under a “Seeded Girls” heading. It was matched to this race by the Heights runners' places.
2020_Holy_Cross_Invitational_1_Open_Boys: The source lists Joe McClorey as grade 9; he was grade 11 in Holy Cross Invitational 2 two weeks later, so grade 11 is used.
2021_WCAC_Championship_Unlabeled_3rd_boy: This third boys race has no title in the source. It is probably the freshman race.
2018_WCAC_Championship_Freshman_moco6852: The posted printout is missing 25 places, so some finishers aren't listed.
2023_WCAC_Championship_Freshman_moco1017: The posted printout is missing 19 places, so some finishers aren't listed.
2023_WCAC_Championship_JV_Varsity_B__moc: The posted printout is missing 15 places, so some finishers aren't listed.
2026_VA_XC_Showcase_JV_Morning_JV__moco1: The posted printout is missing 3 places, so some finishers aren't listed.
2013_Landon_Invitational_Freshman_282634: The source lists Edy McCormack twice (45th, 15:10.2 and 47th, 15:10.6) and Griffin Woofter twice (65th, 16:24.6 and 68th, 16:27.8). Only the first listing of each is kept, and the places after each removed row are moved up by one. The Heights has fewer than 5 runners here, so the team scores are unchanged.
2013_Calverton_Haunted_Halloween_5K_Open: Open community race (the Calverton School's Haunted Halloween 5K): men, women and children from the community ran together and there was no team scoring. The full field is listed as the timer (mdtiming.com) posted it; it gives ages, not grades or schools, so only Heights runners have a school here.
Heights grades are not in the results; they come from each runner's other races that season (or his class year).
All 14 Heights finishers were high school runners (grades 9–12), so this meet is listed under high school only.
Source: mdtiming.com results file; a copy was also posted on calvertonschool.org (Wayback Machine copy linked below).
2014_Calverton_Haunted_Halloween_5K_Open: Open community race (the Calverton School's Haunted Halloween 5K): men, women and children from the community ran together and there was no team scoring. The full field is listed as the timer (mdtiming.com) posted it; it gives ages, not grades or schools, so only Heights runners have a school here.
Heights grades are not in the results; they come from each runner's other races that season (or his class year).

15 Heights high school runners and one middle schooler ran. Reese Smith (8th grade, 8th overall in 20:40) is listed here as “The Heights (middle school)”; his result counts as a middle school result and is on the middle school page for this race.
2010_Calverton_Homecoming_Race_Team_Scor: Tri-meet at Calverton's Homecoming. Only the team scores were published (somdnews.com sports roundup: The Heights 24, St. Mary's Ryken 31, Calverton 85); no individual results for Heights runners have been found.

Conflicting source: Calverton's own schedule page for this date has the note “Chen (4) Heights (19) Gonzaga (25)”. That may be a separate or JV race (“CHEN” is likely a homeschool team), but it doesn't match the roundup and is unresolved. The scores shown are the roundup's. Calverton schedule (Wayback copy): https://web.archive.org/web/20101219040436/http://www.calvertonschool.org/page.cfm?p=303&teamID=25&event=2233&show=detail
The distance isn't stated (Calverton's other home races were 5K), and the level isn't stated either, so this is listed as an open race.
The somdnews page shows an Aug 22, 2011 date; that is when the site moved the article to a new system, not when the meet was held.
2005_Peter_Geraghty_Invitational_Varsity: Official printout used (carrollcountyrunning.com via mocorunning; no grades listed). Racecast has the same race (https://racecast.co/race/xc/30858/133968) but leaves out one finisher (Ryan Smith, Perry Hall, 88th), so its places from 88th on are one lower and its team scores do not match the official ones.
2005_Mercersburg_Invitational_Varsity_50: Racecast title: 10th Mercersburg Academy Invitational. Official team scores: HY-TEK printout (penntrackxc.com via mocorunning, meet 6919).
2005_Mercersburg_Invitational_JV_moco691: The printout says: "NOTE There is a problem with these results. We had several runners without tags so they were counted with a time but not a place. Some of the times may be off." Racecast has only 12 runners for this race, so the printout is used. No grades in the printout.
2005_Gonzaga_St_Andrews_and_The_Heights_: One race for everyone (printout: "Landon Home Meet #3 - Boys 11/04/05", 3 miles, md.milesplit.com via mocorunning meet 6908, which files it under Nov 3). Team scores count each team's first 7; runners marked * / ** in the printout did not count.
2005_Baltimore_Washington_Private_Small_: Printout (mdrunners.com via mocorunning) used: 66 finishers incl. runners from non-scoring schools. Racecast has the same race with 60 (https://racecast.co/race/xc/10991/134465?alt=1, "Baltimore/DC Private School Championships", 5000 m).
Not on racecast. Distance: same course as the varsity races (racecast lists 5000 m for the meet).
Connor Breed is listed as grade 11 here; every other 2005 source lists him in grade 12 (and 2004 sources in grade 11), so grade 12 is used.
2004_Peter_Geraghty_Invitational_Varsity: Date: the HY-TEK printout header (mocorunning meet 4098) and racecast both say 9/8/2004; mocorunning files it as "Mount St. Mary's Invitational", Sep 11, 2004.
2004_Mercersburg_Invitational_Varsity_81: Racecast title: 9th Mercersburg Academy Invitational. Official team scores: printout (penntrackxc.com via mocorunning, meet 6954; team list without places, in order).
2004_Mercersburg_Invitational_Junior_Var: No team scores for the JV race in the printout (mocorunning meet 6954).
2004_Baltimore_Washington_Private_Small_: School names in the printout end in " Boys" (e.g. "Heights Boys"); dropped here. Not on racecast. Course (Oregon Ridge Park, Hunt Valley, MD) from the MileSplit meet page https://md.milesplit.com/meets/8905-baltimore-washington-independent-schools-championship-2004 (the printout does not name it). Distance not stated; 5K inferred from the printout paces.
School names in the printout end in " Boys"; dropped here. Not on racecast. Course from the MileSplit meet page (see varsity race). Distance not stated; 5K inferred from the printout paces.
2003_St_Johns_Invitational_Varsity_13305: Hosted by St. John's at Prospect Hall at Ballenger Creek Park (racecast). Official team scores: printout from mdrunners.com via mocorunning (meet 6054). The printout calls the event "Boys 5280 Yard Run CC" (3 miles), while racecast lists 5000 m; 5000 m is used for paces.
2003_Sandy_Spring_Friends_Meet_Boys_moco: Only the top 20 finishers were posted, mostly by last name only. The three Heights runners are listed as "Krohn", "Hadley" and "Yang"; each matches the only Heights runner with that last name in the 2003 results (William Krohn, Peter Hadley, Willy Yang). The distance and level are not stated.
2003_Georgetown_Prep_Classic_Small_Schoo: Racecast title: 30th Annual Fall Classic 2003, "Boys Small School". The HY-TEK printout (milesplit.com via mocorunning, meet 3406) calls the same race "Men's 5,000 Meter Division I Var Boys" and gives the official team scores (Heights School 14th, 307). Racecast lists Mike Fagan, Jack Bauer, Steve Wyble, Vincent Barrett and Brendan Keats without grades.
2003_Baltimore_Washington_Private_Small_: Only newspaper highlights were posted (mocorunning: "compiled from Montgomery Journal and Washington Post highlights"): the top 6 plus a few local runners, so most places are missing. "William Krosh" (13th, The Heights) is William Krohn (same team, same season; a misspelling). The printout gives Mike Fagan and Peter Hadley the same time, 17:45.07.
Distance: 5K, as confirmed by the team (Nov 2026); the posted results don't state it.
2002_Baltimore_Washington_Private_Small_: The posted results list only the top 5 and a few other runners, so most places are missing. Date: mocorunning files the meet on Saturday, Nov 2, 2002; the printout header says November 11, 2002. The distance is not stated.

1998_Washington_Independent_Schools_Cham: Results and official team scores: the Howard County Striders printout posted on DyeStat (same text on mocorunning, meet 4308). The Heights won the team title with 35 points (Potomac 48); Pat Jacxsens won the race. Mocorunning lists this as The Heights' 1998 DC-MD Small School boys championship. The printout gives no grades and does not state the distance; its pace column (16:14 = 5:13 per mile) implies 5 km. DyeStat's one-line summary gives Jacxsens 16:43, but the printout itself says 16:14.
1997_Washington_Independent_Schools_Cham: Results and official team scores: the Howard County Striders printout posted on DyeStat (same text on mocorunning, meet 5075). Run in the rain (57 F). The printout gives no grades and does not state the distance; its pace column (17:31 = 5:38 per mile) implies 5 km. The Heights placed 5th of 11 teams (126); Pat Jacxsens was 4th (17:53).

Results and official team scores: the Howard County Striders printout posted on DyeStat (same text on mocorunning, meet 5075). Run in the rain (57 F). The printout gives no grades and does not state the distance; its pace column (19:49 = 6:23 per mile) implies 5 km. The Heights placed 3rd of 4 scoring teams (65); Joe Kolf was 12th.
1997_Pallotti_Invitational_Small_School_: Results and official team scores: the meet printout posted on DyeStat (results by Miles Wiegold and Jason Tripp; same text on mocorunning, meet 5062). DyeStat: "Laurel MD, Supplee Field, 5k, sunny & warm". No grades in the printout; long names are cut off at 19 characters. The Heights placed 9th of the scoring small schools (270); Patrick Jacxsens was 14th.

Results and official team scores: the meet printout posted on DyeStat (results by Miles Wiegold and Jason Tripp; same text on mocorunning, meet 5062). The Heights placed 13th of 15 scoring teams (321); Stephen Syski was the first Heights finisher (61st).
2026_Maryland_Private_School_State_Champ: Timed by Windsor Running; results transcribed by mocorunning from Athletic.net. All posted finishers and DNF entries are retained. Distances are 5,000 m; paces are recalculated.

Varsity and Open were separate entry/scoring divisions of the same combined start, with the Open line behind the Varsity line (meet host schedule and DeMatha recap). The MoCo Boys Champion list is a virtual county subset of these same performances, not an additional race.
Timed by Windsor Running; results transcribed by mocorunning from Athletic.net. All posted finishers and DNF entries are retained. Distances are 5,000 m; paces are recalculated.

Varsity and Open were separate entry/scoring divisions of the same combined start, with the Open line behind the Varsity line (meet host schedule and DeMatha recap). The MoCo Boys Champion list is a virtual county subset of these same performances, not an additional race.

Open team scores were not officially kept, according to the DeMatha coach recap. Athletic.net calculated Calvert Hall 26 and The Heights 37 (2nd of 12); these are not official championship standings. The scores shown here are the site calculation, not official team scores. Recap: https://dmcrosscountry.puffett.com/meet-recaps/2026/maryland-private-school-championship

Source discrepancy: mocorunning and the DeMatha recap list 171 Open finishers, while racecast’s meet summary lists 172. The extra racecast entry could not be verified, so no result has been invented or added. The full available mocorunning list is shown.

_about_extra_rows: extra_rows: rows added to a race's results (e.g. a disqualified runner the source lists separately), keyed by race CSV name.
_about_level_overrides: level_overrides: corrected level/label for a race the source mislabels (keyed by race CSV name); the old race id redirects.

_about_drop_rows: drop_rows: duplicate rows for the same runner in one race (keyed by race CSV name); the first listing is kept, the later one is removed and places after it are renumbered.
